source: https://dps.psx.com.pk/indices (PSX's own board), captured once per trading day
note: Append-only index levels. The desk started keeping these on the first run of this script because no daily PSX index history is purchasable or scrapeable anywhere the desk can reach — Yahoo's ^KSE is monthly and dead since 2021.
